text: An alert is the one thing about a pet everyone must know before they walk in: a bite risk, a drug reaction, a fearful cat.
Remember: read the alert before you touch the pet, and add one when the next person needs to know something.
Biscuit Chen has an alert, at the top of his SOAP.
It says what to do, and who wrote it.
Alerts live on the pet's chart. Open it.
Click the pencil on Patient alerts.
Add what the next person needs to know.
It shows on his chart and on every SOAP from now on, with your name.
The most common mistake: an alert that just says careful. Say what to do. Remember: read the alert before you touch the pet, and add one when the next person needs to know something.
